summary: Test-writing phase for issue #39 complete at commit 381219b: solver parity corpus (10 hand-derived cases) + SolverParityCorpusTests, PaletteAPIClientContractTests (wire-contract guard for the generated-client migration), OpenAPIClientMigrationTests (red-phase structural conformance), and docs/solver-parity-corpus.md are committed. All 10 corpus expectations were cross-validated against an independent Python mirror of the Elixir WeightedSquaredError semantics (selections, scores within 1e-9, bitwise-exact ties, exclusion sets). No Swift toolchain exists in this container ('swift: command not found'), so swift test could not be executed here — the repo's own bin/lint skips the Swift build in that case; the suite must run on a macOS host. Implementation criteria (generated client in place, README link, PR-description notes) are deferred to the implementation run per the test-writing phase rules; the committed tests are the settling verification for them.
